# Telegram Messenger
> Telegram is a cloud-based messaging platform offering fast, secure communication apps, APIs, bots, and developer tools.

Telegram provides consumer messaging apps alongside extensive developer resources for building bots, integrating login, and creating custom clients with the Telegram API and MTProto protocol.

## Main Site
- [Telegram Home](https://telegram.org/): Overview of Telegram Messenger, core features, apps, and platform links.
- [FAQ](https://telegram.org/faq): Answers to common questions about accounts, privacy, security, and app behavior.
- [Apps](https://telegram.org/apps): Official Telegram apps for mobile, desktop, and web platforms.
- [Desktop Apps](https://desktop.telegram.org/): Official Telegram Desktop clients and related download information.
- [Web Apps](https://web.telegram.org/): Browser-based Telegram clients for messaging without installing software.
- [Blog](https://telegram.org/blog): Official product announcements, feature updates, and platform news.
- [Privacy Policy](https://telegram.org/privacy): Telegram’s privacy practices, data handling, and user protections.
- [Terms of Service](https://telegram.org/tos): Terms governing use of Telegram apps, services, and platform features.

## Downloads and Clients
- [Android](https://telegram.org/android): Official Telegram app download page for Android devices.
- [iPhone/iPad](https://telegram.org/dl/ios): Official Telegram app access point for iOS devices.
- [macOS](https://telegram.org/dl/macos): Official Telegram app download page for macOS.
- [Windows](https://telegram.org/dl/desktop/win64): Direct Telegram Desktop download for 64-bit Windows systems.
- [Linux](https://telegram.org/dl/desktop/linux): Telegram Desktop download options for Linux systems.
- [Portable Desktop](https://telegram.org/dl/desktop/win_portable): Portable Telegram Desktop build for Windows without installation.

## Developer Platform
- [Telegram API](https://core.telegram.org/api): Overview of Telegram’s API platform for building custom clients and integrations.
- [MTProto Mobile Protocol](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto): Technical documentation for Telegram’s MTProto transport and encryption protocol.
- [API Obtaining api_id](https://core.telegram.org/api/obtaining_api_id): Instructions for registering applications and getting Telegram API credentials.
- [TDLib](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib): Cross-platform client library for building Telegram apps with a stable interface.
- [Telegram Database Library](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib/docs): TDLib documentation, concepts, and implementation details for developers.
- [API Terms of Service](https://core.telegram.org/api/terms): Terms for developers using Telegram APIs and platform services.

## Bot Development
- [Bots Introduction](https://core.telegram.org/bots): Overview of Telegram bots, capabilities, and platform concepts.
- [Bot API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api): Complete HTTP Bot API reference for building Telegram bots.
- [Bot Payments](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments): Guide to accepting payments through Telegram bots.
- [Bot Games](https://core.telegram.org/bots/games): Documentation for building and integrating HTML5 games with bots.
- [Bot Features](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features): Summary of bot capabilities, interaction models, and supported platform features.
- [Inline Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline): Guide to inline mode and in-chat bot interactions.

## Login and Widgets
- [Telegram Login](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login): Widget for authenticating users on external websites with Telegram.
- [Comments Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/comments): Embedded comments platform powered by Telegram discussions.
- [Post Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/post): Widget for embedding Telegram channel posts on websites.
- [Share Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/share): Button and widget for sharing links through Telegram.
- [Widget Platform](https://core.telegram.org/widgets): Overview of Telegram website widgets and embedding options.

## Mini Apps and Web Apps
- [Web Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps): Guide to building rich web applications inside Telegram bots.
- [Mini Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps): Platform documentation for interactive in-app web experiences in Telegram.
- [Games Platform](https://core.telegram.org/bots/games): HTML5 game integrations launched from Telegram bots.
- [Payments for Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments): Payment flows and invoicing support for bot-based commerce experiences.

## Client API Guides
- [Working with Updates](https://core.telegram.org/api/updates): How Telegram delivers updates, events, and state changes to clients.
- [Authorization](https://core.telegram.org/api/auth): Authentication flows for Telegram client applications.
- [Chats, Channels and Supergroups](https://core.telegram.org/api/channel): Concepts and API methods for channels and large group chats.
- [Stickers](https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers): Sticker and emoji-related API objects, methods, and file handling.
- [Files](https://core.telegram.org/api/files): Uploading, downloading, and managing files through Telegram APIs.
- [Deep Linking](https://core.telegram.org/api/links): Telegram deep links and URI schemes for app interactions.

## Security and Protocol
- [MTProto Overview](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto): Core protocol architecture, transport, and cryptographic design.
- [MTProto 2.0](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto/description): Detailed description of Telegram’s MTProto 2.0 protocol.
- [Security Guidelines](https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end): Information about end-to-end encryption and secret chats.
- [Perfect Forward Secrecy](https://core.telegram.org/api/pfs): Explanation of key rotation and forward secrecy in secret chats.
- [Security FAQ](https://telegram.org/faq#security): Security-related answers for end users and administrators.

## News and Updates
- [Telegram Blog](https://telegram.org/blog): Official archive of Telegram announcements and feature releases.
- [Recent News](https://telegram.org/blog): Latest updates highlighted from the Telegram homepage.
- [Telegram FAQ](https://telegram.org/faq): Ongoing reference for product changes and user-facing behavior.
- [Apps Page](https://telegram.org/apps): Current app availability and links to official clients across platforms.
